description: Staged-pipeline SmartBuild deck builder. One installable unit.

python_optional: jsonschema (full plan validation; falls back to structural checks if absent)
runtime.node: not required to build; the deck itself is plain HTML/CSS/JS
runtime.browser: Any modern Chromium/Firefox/Safari to view. Export (PPTX/PDF) needs internet to load pinned libraries.

design_skill.note: Brand tokens are extracted from the `design` skill. Re-extract and bump token_version if the brand system changes.

export_libraries.sri_note: Fill SRI integrity hashes in engine/build.py CDN map before client-facing export use; preflight warns if empty.

license_checks: Images: prefer owned/generated (approved_for_client). Client export blocked unless every resolved asset approved_for_client.

run.sweep: python engine/validate.py --skill-path . --plan plan.json --out out && python engine/fidelity.py --plan plan.json --out out
